<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 120.042 Da, matching the observed mass within a few ppm and fitting the isotopic pattern (M+1 peak at ~122.056). Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
